title: Adding custom fields to sales invoice and pull data from the customer doctype?

posts.cooked:
Hello.
I want to add a field to my customer record to track how documents are sent to the customer, email, fax, mail, Etc.
This was easy and that field is added and working. Now i want to pull that value on doctypes like sales invoice, subscription, and others.
So i add a custom field to sales invoice with the following params. field type: data
fetch from: Customer-custom_send_via
This field shows in the sales invoice but does not pull the field from the customer record.
What am i missing?
